# PlainBTC

> Plain-English Bitcoin & crypto news for beginners

Plain-English Bitcoin and crypto news and beginner guides. Official site: https://plainbtc.com

## English

- [PlainBTC](https://plainbtc.com/): Plain-English Bitcoin and crypto news, market recaps, and beginner guides for U.S. readers. Updated November 2026.
- [About PlainBTC](https://plainbtc.com/about): What PlainBTC is: plain-English Bitcoin and crypto news for beginners, with clear disclosures and no financial advice.
- [Affiliate & referral disclosure](https://plainbtc.com/disclosure): FTC-compliant affiliate disclosure for PlainBTC: Coinbase, Gemini, and River referral links on English pages, Uphold on Spanish and Portuguese pages, and not financial advice.
- [Bitcoin slips below $67,000 as ETF investors pull $1.07 billion in a week](https://plainbtc.com/articles/bitcoin-below-67000-sixth-weekly-loss-nov-2026): Bitcoin hit its lowest price since Aug. 19 as spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $1.07 billion this week and fear gauges sank deeper into "extreme fear."
- [Indian exchange Unocoin says hackers used its old paper backup keys to take about $200,000 in crypto](https://plainbtc.com/articles/unocoin-hack-bitgo-backup-keys-nov-2026): Unocoin says hackers used its own backup keys to drain three hot wallets of about $200,000, getting around a freeze at custody firm BitGo. Customer data may also be exposed.
- [Falling prices squeeze crypto treasury firms: Nakamoto owes Kraken $165 million, BTCS sells ether to protect a loan](https://plainbtc.com/articles/crypto-treasury-firms-loans-nakamoto-btcs-nov-2026): Nakamoto owes Kraken $165 million against its bitcoin and pushed repayment into 2027, while BTCS sold ether at a loss to keep a $64 million Aave loan safe.
- [Kraken parent Payward's earnings drop two-thirds from a year ago as crypto trading cools](https://plainbtc.com/articles/kraken-payward-q3-2026-results-nov-2026): Kraken's parent Payward said Q3 adjusted EBITDA fell to $60 million from $178.6 million a year earlier as trading slowed, while funded accounts rose 37% to 7.1 million.
- [DOJ, Wall Street and DeFi firms back lawsuit against Illinois' 0.2% crypto tax](https://plainbtc.com/articles/illinois-crypto-tax-doj-defi-challenge-nov-2026): The DOJ, Wall Street's biggest lobby and top DeFi firms back a lawsuit against Illinois' 0.2% tax on crypto trades, transfers and storage. The tax is paused until July 2027.
- [DTCC plans to bring tokenized stocks, ETFs and Treasuries to Solana in 2027](https://plainbtc.com/articles/dtcc-tokenized-stocks-solana-2027-nov-2026): Wall Street's settlement giant DTCC will connect its tokenization service to Solana in the second half of 2027, bringing tokenized stocks, ETFs and Treasuries to the network.
- [Bitcoin falls below $70,000 and its 200-week average as traders bet on a Fed rate hike](https://plainbtc.com/articles/bitcoin-below-70000-200-week-average-nov-2026): Bitcoin fell below $70,000 for the first time since August and dipped under its 200-week average as traders priced in a December Fed rate hike.
- [Trump names four SEC and CFTC nominees, including a replacement for crypto advocate Hester Peirce](https://plainbtc.com/articles/trump-nominates-sec-cftc-commissioners-peirce-nov-2026): Trump nominated two people each to the SEC and CFTC, including Steven Levine to replace crypto advocate Hester Peirce. All four need Senate approval.
- [U.S. gets court approval to seize $1.2 billion stolen in the Binance hack and disrupts a North Korean fake video call scheme](https://plainbtc.com/articles/doj-seizes-1-2-billion-binance-hack-north-korea-nov-2026): The Justice Department can now seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion stolen in the Binance hack, and the FBI disrupted North Korea's FaceStealer fake video call scheme.
- [MSCI will drop Strategy from its indexes as bitcoin slides to its lowest price since August](https://plainbtc.com/articles/msci-drops-strategy-bitcoin-falls-nvidia-nov-2026): MSCI confirmed it will remove Strategy, the largest corporate bitcoin holder, from its global indexes after Nov. 30, as bitcoin slid to its lowest price since August.
- [SEC backs the CFTC on stock perpetuals and clears options on more crypto ETFs](https://plainbtc.com/articles/sec-backs-cftc-stock-perps-crypto-etf-options-nov-2026): The SEC sided with the CFTC in a court fight over stock perpetual futures and cleared Nasdaq ISE to list options on crypto ETFs that hold assets beyond bitcoin and ether.
- [Stablecoin supply shrinks at the fastest pace since 2022 as Tether's USDT loses $6.6 billion](https://plainbtc.com/articles/stablecoin-supply-shrinks-usdt-tether-nov-2026): Stablecoin supply is shrinking at its fastest pace since 2022, with Tether's USDT down $6.6 billion in 60 days. Analysts say that leaves less buying power for bitcoin.
- [Hackers hijack crypto bridge Across's website through its domain registrar; about $350,000 drained](https://plainbtc.com/articles/across-protocol-domain-hijack-phishing-nov-2026): Hackers hijacked crypto bridge Across's website through its domain registrar and drained an estimated $350,000. Across says affected users will be made whole.
- [OKX and NYSE owner ICE set Nov. 23 launch for 24/7 tokenized stock trading in the U.S.](https://plainbtc.com/articles/okxice-tokenized-stocks-launch-nov-23-2026): OKX and NYSE owner ICE will open 24/7 trading of tokenized U.S. stocks on Nov. 23, with Coinbase, Circle, Strategy and 59 Direxion ETFs among 70+ assets.
